{"body":"**Normalized organization collisions can rewrite an exact canonical ID to another canonical organization**

The rewrite occurs when an exact canonical ID wins first but a normalized spelling collides across organizations.
The exact canonical ID can then identify the wrong canonical organization.
Make exact canonical IDs win first, and resolve a normalized spelling only when one organization owns it.
